ITEM TEXT
There
is
something
hard
to
resist
about
cherries
.
The
small
red
fruit
is
a
popular
seasonal
food
around
the
world
.
In
northern
areas
,
cherry
trees
are
just
beginning
to
produce
flowers
.
The
cherry
is
a
member
of
the
same
family
of
plants
as
the
rose
.
It
is
closely
related
to
the
plum
.
Like
cherry
trees
,
plum
trees
also
flower
in
early
spring
.
Cherries
are
thought
to
be
native
to
Western
Asia
.
There
are
two
major
kinds
of
cherries
harvested
in
the
world
:
sweet
and
sour
.
Sour
cherries
are
not
eaten
fresh
because
they
contain
little
sugar
.
Instead
,
they
are
processed
to
start
prepared
foods
like
jellies
and
pies
and
to
start
alcoholic
drinks
.
The
United
States
is
a
major
producer
of
sour
cherries
.
Among
the
states
,
Michigan
is
the
top
producer
.
